name: tape-start
prompt: Reel-to-reel tape machine starting: the mechanical clunk of the play key, then the motor and reels spinning up and running steadily

name: station
moment: the needle settles on a station (soft, quiet, neutral: not a right/wrong signal)
prompt: One tiny soft click of a small plastic switch, very quiet and short, clean and dry, no tone, no hum, no static, no ringing

name: file-open
moment: a station file is opened (read the evidence)
prompt: A single sheet of paper slid out of a manila card folder onto a desk, crisp paper rustle, close up

name: reframe
prompt: One firm click of a vintage bakelite push-button switch being pressed

name: strip-feed
moment: the next transcript line feeds out of the slot
prompt: Teleprinter paper tape feeding out of a machine slot, short fast mechanical ratchet and paper sliding

name: punch
moment: Submit confirmed: the tag is punched and hung (the commit)
prompt: A heavy steel hand ticket punch biting through thick card stock with a sharp metallic chunk, then the card tag dropped onto a metal hook

name: lock-right
moment: reveal, source named right: the magic eye holds open
prompt: Short soft pleasant two-note bell chime, rising, gentle and bright, clean, no hum, no buzz

name: lock-wrong
moment: reveal, source named wrong: the magic eye flutters shut
prompt: Old tube radio losing its station: a harsh crackle of static and a wavering detuned whistle that drifts off and fades

name: counter
moment: the unanswered-pitches counter clicks up (the counter face bumps at the same moment)
prompt: A mechanical tally counter number wheel clicking over by one, heavy metal ratchet clack

name: hidden-lit
moment: end of the tape: the competitor in the account lights up on the dial
prompt: Gentle warm three-note rising chime with soft sparkle, calm reveal, clean and bright, no hum, no buzz, no drone
